title: Rotation and Recovery
summary: Recovered a 128-bit key from a stateful protocol using an adversary-in-the-middle seat, a verification oracle, and a factorable key schedule, then cut the edit cost with a two-stage residue lift.

title: Deanonymizing a Wi-Fi Device from a Probe-Request Capture
summary: Found the one device in a 39,000-device Wi-Fi probe capture that never randomized its MAC, then read its leaked saved-network list back as a travel itinerary. The whole solve turned on a single bit.
